name: HalluLens
description: A comprehensive hallucination benchmark for large language models that introduces a clear taxonomy distinguishing extrinsic and intrinsic hallucinations, includes new extrinsic hallucination tasks with dynamic test set generation to prevent data leakage, and provides analysis of existing benchmarks.
reputation: A recent hallucination benchmark that is gaining attention for its taxonomy and dynamic test generation, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on hallucination taxonomy and dynamic test set generation to ensure robustness.
